svg.text: Cmod A7-35T + TinyVGA + TM1638 + INMP441 + GY-PCM5102, 3.3 V from a regulator

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board configuration cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude. The Cmod A7 sits in a breadboard across its center channel, its USB end at the end of the breadboard; the modules connect with jumper wires.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cmod A7 is seen from the component side. Each board pin shows its DIP pin number; the used pins also show their signal.

svg.text: SCK to GND. Solder jumpers on the back: FLT L, DEMP L, XSMT H, FMT L.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: INMP441 L/R is driven low by the FPGA; you may connect it to GND instead and leave DIP 19 free.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Unplug USB before changing the wiring. VU, DIP 24, goes to the regulator input only: the DIP pins take 3.3 V at most.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DIP 48 to 26 and 1 to 11 are the GPIO pins of the labs, gpio[0] to gpio[33]; GPn is gpio[n]. Nothing is connected to them here.
